markup:
The size of portable power station you need depends on **what devices you want to power, how much electricity they use, and how long you need them to run.**

There are two important specifications:

- **Battery capacity (Wh):** How long the power station can run your devices.
- **Output power (W):** How many watts it can supply at once.

## Quick sizing guide

| Power station capacity | Typical use |
|---|---|
| 200–300 Wh | Phones, laptops, small lights |
| 500 Wh | Laptop, fan, router, weekend camping |
| 1,000 Wh | Mini fridge, TV, multiple electronics |
| 2,000 Wh | Full-size refrigerator, emergency home backup |
| 3,000–4,000 Wh | Refrigerator, lights, electronics for extended outages |
| 5,000+ Wh | Larger home backup needs |

## Estimate how much capacity you need

The basic formula is:

\[
\text{Capacity (Wh)}=\frac{\text{Watts}\times\text{Hours}}{0.85}
\]

The 0.85 accounts for approximate energy losses when using AC outlets.

For example, a 100W device running for 8 hours needs approximately **940 Wh**, so a 1,000 Wh power station would be a reasonable starting point.

## Calculate your power station size

Enter the devices you want to run and how long you'll use them.

{@body const presets=[{name:"Phone charging",w:15,h:3},{name:"Laptop",w:60,h:5},{name:"Wi-Fi router",w:12,h:24},{name:"Refrigerator (average)",w:60,h:24},{name:"Fan",w:40,h:8},{name:"TV",w:100,h:4},{name:"CPAP machine",w:40,h:8},{name:"LED lights",w:20,h:6},{name:"Microwave",w:1200,h:0.25}]}
{@body const [devices,setDevices]=DIL.useState([{name:"Wi-Fi router",w:12,h:24},{name:"Refrigerator (average)",w:60,h:24}])}
{@body const energy=devices.reduce((s,d)=>s+d.w*d.h,0)}
{@body const needed=Math.ceil(energy/0.85)}
{@body const peak=devices.reduce((s,d)=>s+d.w,0)}
{@body const capacity=[300,500,1000,1500,2000,3000,4000,5000,6000].find(n=>n>=needed)||Math.ceil(needed/1000)*1000}
<box border radius="2xl" padding={3} gap={3}>
  <text weight="medium">Add devices</text>
  <row wrap="wrap" gap={2}>
    {#each presets as p}
      <button key={p.name} size="sm" variant="outline" color="secondary" disabled={devices.some(d=>d.name===p.name)} onClick={()=>setDevices([...devices,{...p}])}><icon name="plus" size="xs"/>{p.name}</button>
    {/each}
  </row>
  <divider color="subtle"/>
  <grid columns={["1fr","90px","75px","32px"]} gap={2}>
    <grid-item><label>Device</label></grid-item>
    <grid-item><label>Watts</label></grid-item>
    <grid-item><label>Hours</label></grid-item>
    <grid-item/>
    {#each devices as d,i}
      <grid-item><box justify="center" height="100%"><text size="sm">{d.name}</text></box></grid-item>
      <grid-item><input size="md" inputType="number" value={String(d.w)} onChange={v=>setDevices(ds=>ds.map((x,j)=>j===i?{...x,w:Math.max(0,Number(v)||0)}:x))}/></grid-item>
      <grid-item><input size="md" inputType="number" value={String(d.h)} onChange={v=>setDevices(ds=>ds.map((x,j)=>j===i?{...x,h:Math.max(0,Number(v)||0)}:x))}/></grid-item>
      <grid-item><button size="sm" variant="ghost" color="secondary" uniform onClick={()=>setDevices(ds=>ds.filter((_,j)=>j!==i))}><icon name="x"/></button></grid-item>
    {/each}
  </grid>
  <box background="surface-secondary" radius="xl" padding={3} gap={2}>
    <text color="secondary" weight="medium" size="xs">RECOMMENDED BATTERY CAPACITY</text>
    <title size="2xl" color="default" tabularNums>{capacity.toLocaleString()} Wh</title>
    <divider color="subtle"/>
    <grid columns={2} gap={2}>
      <grid-item>
        <text color="secondary" size="xs">Estimated energy required</text>
        <title size="lg" tabularNums>{needed.toLocaleString()} Wh</title>
      </grid-item>
      <grid-item>
        <text color="secondary" size="xs">Combined running load</text>
        <title size="lg" tabularNums>{peak.toLocaleString()} W</title>
      </grid-item>
    </grid>
  </box>
  <caption>Assumes 85% usable energy. Refrigerator compressors and some other appliances have startup surges, so the inverter's continuous and surge ratings must also be checked. Running hours are approximate.</caption>
</box>

**One question:** What's your main use case?

{@body const [use,setUse]=DIL.useState("Home backup during outages")}
<box gap={2}>
  <radio-group direction="col" value={use} onChange={setUse}>
    <radio value="Home backup during outages">Home backup during outages</radio>
    <radio value="Camping or road trips">Camping or road trips</radio>
    <radio value="Powering appliances or tools">Powering appliances or tools</radio>
    <radio value="Off-grid living or solar power">Off-grid living or solar power</radio>
  </radio-group>
  <button block onClick={()=>GenUI.issueNewTurn("I need a portable power station for "+use+". Help me choose the right battery capacity and output rating.")}>Continue <icon name="arrow-right" size="sm"/></button>
</box>
